cards.card_text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed, and the future of the wicked will be cut off.
cards.verse_text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
cards.snippet: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut…

cards.card_text: David says he'll teach transgressors God's ways.
cards.verse_text: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
cards.snippet: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD calls out to transgressors: remember this, take it to heart and be brave.
cards.verse_text: Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!
cards.snippet: Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!

cards.card_text: He was numbered with the transgressors.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors.
cards.snippet: …poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors.

cards.card_text: The Servant was numbered with the transgressors.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors.
cards.snippet: …poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus points to a Scripture about Himself, from the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 53:12): “And He was numbered with the transgressors.”
cards.verse_text: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
cards.snippet: …Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”

cards.card_text: True or false: James says that if they show favoritism, they sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
cards.verse_text: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
cards.snippet: …you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
